description:
Mahjong meets ancient combat!

In Warriors Waifus Mahjong, you’ll face off against legendary female warriors from across time and cultures! Each level pits you against one of these fierce fighters in a unique Mahjong puzzle battle. With 60 levels of intense gameplay, your strategic skills and quick thinking will be tested as you race against the clock.

Fail to complete the puzzle before time runs out, and you’ll be the laughingstock of the ancient world…


Features:

* Matching 3 gameplay (mahjong)
* Beautiful pixel art
* HD artwork of the warriors to unlock
* 60 levels
* Image gallery
* 6 different waifus
* Orchestral Soundtrack
name: Warriors Waifus Mahjong
intro: Quick thinking and strategic skill will earn you victory.
